title: 第3章 天上砸下个九阳血脉第4章 我嫌臭
lines: 夜幕下。
林铮的身影快速进入天罚山脉。
气海碎裂，境界跌落到先天境，林铮始终还是武者。
“塔爷，以我现在的实力，恐怕只能猎杀一些普通的一级妖兽，有用吗？”
“没办法，灵兽等级不够数量凑，从现在开始，你只管猎杀灵兽，等汇聚到一定数量，塔爷炼化灵兽帮你重聚气海。”
整个山脉到处都是妖兽横行，越往深处，妖兽等级越高。
所以林铮根本不敢深入，只是留在外围猎杀。
“一级妖兽三耳兔。”
锁定三耳兔，林铮立刻铆足速度追了上去，可惜三耳兔的速度太快，只能眼睁睁的看着消失。
“你这速度还真是不堪。”
“废话，我没有气海支持，速度必定会大打折扣。”
“那你要快点了。”
一夜猎杀，林铮拼尽全力的猎杀，终于在黎明之前猎杀了两百多只一级妖兽，堆积如山。
“够吗？”
“不够，但我先炼化帮你修复一些气海。”
一屁股坐在地上，靠着大树大口大口喘息着。
没有气海支持，猎杀妖兽实在太累了。
眉宇间闪过一丝黑光，弑神塔突然悬浮在妖兽尸体上，黑光笼罩堆积如山的妖兽尸体，开始炼化起来。
“什么东西！”
此刻。
一团火焰残影从天而降，甚至不等林铮躲闪，直接狠狠地砸了上来。
“断了。”
一脚将身上的东西踹开，林铮站起身，双手捂着小弟疼的直蹦跶。
“终于蹦出来了，差点断子绝孙。”
疼的冷汗直流，也确实被吓坏了。
要是断了，做男人还有何乐趣。
转过身看向刚刚砸在自己身上的东西，一看之下，林铮有些惊讶。
“女人？”
躺在地上的女子全身穿着火红色长裙，眼若星河，淡淡的柳叶眉，满头火红色长发如瀑布般，身上到处都是血迹，很明显受了重创。
一声妖兽咆哮从远处传来。
“这吼声，这头妖兽的实力太强大，还是先避开再说。”
“小子，你捡到宝了，赶快带走这个丫头。”
“塔爷，什么宝？你要说清楚，我可不会帮你做逼良为娼的事情。”
“她可以帮你重聚气海。”
双眼一亮，半信半疑的林铮，在极其不情愿的情况下，双手抱起女子快速离去。
不一会后。
一头通体黑蓝色的妖狼窜了出来，狠狠的嗅着空气中的气味。
消失了？
一个受到重创的人类，怎么可能无缘无故的消失。
山洞内。
“放心，我已经消除了小丫头身上的气息，妖兽不会追来。”
将女子直接丢在地上，林铮累的坐在地上，皱着眉头问道：“她如何帮我重聚气海？我们先说好，双修肯定不行，我还是雏，可不想在这种地方失去我的第一次。”
“装清纯。”
“别废话，赶快说。”
林铮很重视破碎的气海，想要参加第二次天梯考核，必须要重聚气海，恢复到聚灵境。
content_en:
Under night.
Lin Zheng's figure quickly entered the Tianpu Mountain Range.
The sea of ​​qi shattered and his realm fell to the innate realm, but Lin Zheng was still a warrior.
"Master Tower, with my current strength, I'm afraid I can only hunt some ordinary first-level monsters. Is it useful?"
"There is no way, the spirit beast levels are not enough to gather enough numbers. From now on, you just hunt the spirit beasts. When a certain number is gathered, Master Ta will refine the spirit beasts to help you reunite the Qi Sea."
The entire mountain range is infested with monsters. The deeper you go, the higher the level of the monsters.
Therefore, Lin Zheng did not dare to go deep at all, and just stayed on the outside to hunt.
"First-level monster three-eared rabbit."
Locking on the three-eared rabbit, Lin Zheng immediately chased after him at full speed. Unfortunately, the three-eared rabbit was too fast and could only watch it disappear.
"Your speed is really unbearable."
"Nonsense, I don't have the support of Qi Hai, so my speed will be greatly reduced."
"Then you have to hurry up."
After a night of hunting, Lin Zheng tried his best to hunt, and finally killed more than two hundred first-level monsters before dawn, which piled up like a mountain.
"Is it enough?"
"It's not enough, but I'll refine it first to help you repair some Qi Hai."
He sat down on the ground and leaned against the tree, breathing heavily.
Without the support of Qi Hai, hunting monsters is too tiring.
A trace of black light flashed between the brows, and the God-killing Tower suddenly floated over the corpse of the monster beast. The black light enveloped the mountain of monster corpses and began to be refined.
"What the hell!"
at this moment.
An afterimage of flames fell from the sky, and even before Lin Zheng could dodge, it hit it hard.
"Broken."
Kicking away the things on his body, Lin Zheng stood up, covering his little brother with his hands and jumping up and down in pain.
"It finally popped out, and I almost lost my descendants."
It was so painful that I was sweating profusely, and I was really frightened.
If it's broken, what's the fun in being a man?
Lin Zheng turned around and looked at the thing that had just hit him. At first glance, Lin Zheng was a little surprised.
"Woman?"
The woman lying on the ground was wearing a fiery red dress, with eyes like stars, light willow eyebrows, and long fiery red hair like a waterfall. There were blood stains everywhere on her body. It was obvious that she had been severely injured.
A monster roar came from the distance.
"This roar, this monster is too powerful, I'd better avoid it first."
"Boy, you found a treasure, take this girl away quickly."
"Master Ta, what treasure? You must make it clear that I will not help you force girls into prostitution."
"She can help you regain your energy."
Lin Zheng's eyes lit up and he was dubious. With great reluctance, he picked up the woman with both hands and left quickly.
After a while.
A black and blue demonic wolf sprang out, sniffing the air.
Disappeared?
How could a severely damaged human being disappear for no reason?
Inside the cave.
"Don't worry, I have eliminated the aura from the little girl, and the monsters will not come after her."
Throwing the woman directly to the ground, Lin Zheng sat on the ground tiredly, frowning and asked: "How can she help me regain my Qi sea? Let's agree first. Dual cultivation is definitely not possible. I am still a young girl, and I don't want to lose my first time in a place like this."
"Pretend to be innocent."
"Stop talking nonsense and speak quickly."
Lin Zheng attaches great importance to the broken sea of ​​qi. If he wants to participate in the second ladder assessment, he must reunite the sea of ​​qi and return to the spirit gathering realm.
